card.line: India was the eastern edge of King Xerxes' huge Persian kingdom, the far end of his 127 provinces, which stretched from India to Cush.

moments.title: The edge of Xerxes' kingdom
moments.text: The book of Esther begins by saying that Xerxes ruled 127 provinces from India to Cush. Then it tells of his great feast, where he showed off the riches of his kingdom.

moments.title: Mordecai's letters reach India
moments.text: Mordecai's orders for the Jews were written in the king's name and sent to the 127 provinces from India to Cush. Each province got the letter in its own script and language.
